_comment: Equivalence bands for agent-ab-inprocess-001, committed BEFORE the run as part of docs/preregistrations/2026-08-27-in-process-vs-mcp-transport.md. Consumed by scripts/agent_ab_compare_drivers.py, which refuses any compared metric with no row here. Baseline is agent-ab-sdk-replication-001 (same tasks, same driver, same corpus, memory over external stdio MCP). max_abs_diff rows are falsifiers; min is a wiring floor that voids the run; record_only rows are recorded and never falsify because the transport changes them mechanically. NOTE the bands are the SAME widths as the driver-equivalence run, deliberately: this asks the same shape of question about a different swap, and widening them here after seeing that run's numbers would be choosing the criterion to fit the answer.
